reuse.why: Reuses assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse, BankSyncError and the getServer config pattern, but the link body and the download function are written as copies of existing provider functions rather than shared.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkPluggyAiAccount/linkSimpleFinAccount (upgrade-or-insert, payee, sync, notify), and downloadFintegraTransactions copies the existing per-provider download pattern.

placement.why: Each piece lands where the tree puts its provider peers: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Focused on Fintegra; the two small desktop-client edits are forced by Record<BankSyncProviders,...> typing despite the request saying server-only.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern so it is easy to read, but adds another ~80-line copy of the link flow and a ~40-line download copy that must be kept in sync by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; it uses the existing duplicate-link guard, bank lookup and sync response handler

disguised_duplication.where: the copies are plain, not renamed or reshaped: linkFintegraAccount mirrors linkPluggyAiAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions mirrors the other download* functions
